title: Georgios Monachos (Hamartolos), Chronicon syntomon, Book I (Adam to Alexander); «Хроника Георгия Амартола», кн. I
author: Georgios Monachos (Hamartolos)
genre: Byzantine monastic world chronicle (ancient and biblical history)
size: Whole work: de Boor, 2 vols, c. 800 pp. Book I (Adam, Nimrod, Persians, Chaldaeans, Brahmans, Amazons, Alexander) est. 25–35k words
edition: C. de Boor, Teubner 1904 (public domain); corrected reprint by Wirth 1978
ru_evidence: No modern Russian. Only the medieval Old Slavonic translation (ed. Istrin) and Senina 2012 (Leo V reign excerpt), per ru.wikipedia
en_evidence: en.wikipedia lists only editions (Muralt 1859, PG 110, de Boor 1904). No English translation found
other_translations: Medieval Slavonic and Georgian (Arsen of Iqalto) only. No modern translation found
value: The Slavonic 'Amartol' shaped Russian chronicle writing (the Primary Chronicle). Book I carries ancient lore: Brahmans (via Palladius), Alexander, Persian and Chaldaean material. A facing-text translation would serve Byzantinists, Slavists and Alexander-tradition scholars, and connects directly to the editor's expertise.
ai_feasibility: High: Koine with patristic quotations. Source identification (Palladius, Josephus, Theodoret) is needed
pilot_unit: The Book I sections on Alexander and the Brahmans, est. 5–7k words
